style.art: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. Bright cheerful palette (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky blue). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image.
style.object: A single object only, centered, filling most of the frame, on a plain pure white background, no ground shadow, nothing else in the picture. Draw exactly what is described and nothing more: animals look natural with no clothes, hats, bags, tools or accessories unless the description says so; no extra props.
style.scene: Full illustrated scene: the background is made of a few large flat color shapes (ground, bushes, sky) with a calm plain sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. Letter trees are ordinary round leafy trees with small fruits (like an orchard); never shape trees, clouds, paths or any object like letters of the alphabet.
style.character_sheet: Full body, standing, facing the viewer, friendly expression, centered on a plain pure white background, no shadow, no props beyond what is described.

pip.name: Pip
pip.desc: a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf
pip.personality: a baby songbird that can read short words now; it says the two letters of a pair apart at first (s... h...), then mixes up the order of blends (lb for bl); in Unit 5 it copies Grumble's shh and says its first pair sound, sh!, and in Unit 10 it opens the last door of the forest by itself and sings
pip.role_ko: 단어를 읽게 된 아기 새. 두 글자 짝꿍을 "스… 흐…" 따로따로 말하다가 5유닛에서 처음으로 "sh!"를 말해요.

bun.name: Bun
bun.desc: a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile
bun.personality: brave and curious, always the first to shout the sound
bun.role_ko: 씩씩한 토끼. 제일 먼저 나서요. "해 보자!"

hedgie.name: Hedgie
hedgie.desc: a small hedgehog standing on two legs, soft spikes with one tiny flower stuck in them, curious cautious eyes
hedgie.personality: careful and thoughtful, great at finding hidden things
hedgie.role_ko: 조심스러운 고슴도치. 숨은 물건을 잘 찾아요. "우와!"

grumble.name: Grumble
grumble.desc: a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers
grumble.personality: the grumpy old raccoon, now sleeping in a leafy treetop bed in the Pair Forest and saying Shh! from the branches; his Shh! turns out to be exactly the sh sound and opens the first door; he climbs a little lower every unit, shares snacks and lends his lantern, and drums at the show
grumble.role_ko: 나무 위 침대에서 "쉿!" 하는 너구리 할아버지. 그 "쉿!"이 바로 sh 소리예요. 조금씩 내려와 친구가 돼요.

beads.name: Beads
beads.desc: a small friendly caterpillar whose body is a string of five round beads in rainbow colors (red, orange, yellow, green, blue), big round sparkling eyes, two tiny antennae tipped with little beads, a cheerful open smile, no letters on the beads
beads.personality: a bead caterpillar who threads letter beads together to make words; counts beads, clicks them together, says the whole word proudly after the sounds
beads.role_ko: 구슬 애벌레. 글자 구슬을 꿰어 단어를 만들어요. "딸깍딸깍!"

twins.name: Pim & Pam
twins.desc: two tiny twin bluebirds always side by side, one with a small red feather tuft and one with a small yellow feather tuft, round sky-blue bodies with white bellies, big shiny black eyes, tiny orange beaks, their inner wingtips touching, drawn together as one pair, no letters anywhere
twins.personality: twin bluebirds who are never apart and always speak at exactly the same time; together they show how two letters make one sound (sh, ch, th) or glide two sounds into one (bl, st); they guide the friends through the doors of the Pair Forest
twins.role_ko: 늘 붙어 다니는 쌍둥이 파랑새. 둘이 동시에 말해서 두 글자가 한 소리를 내게 해요. "함께!"

pose_desc.ref: standing straight, arms relaxed at the sides, friendly smile, looking at the viewer
pose_desc.happy: jumping with both arms raised high, big open-mouth smile
pose_desc.surprised: eyes wide, mouth open in an O, hands up near the face
pose_desc.pointing: pointing to the right with one arm fully extended, looking that way, excited
pose_desc.thinking: one finger on the chin, looking up, puzzled
pose_desc.cheering: both fists raised in victory, laughing
pose_desc.glow: glowing brightly with little sparkles around, eyes closed in delight
pose_desc.sad: drooping leaf, big sad eyes, a single tear
pose_desc.hiding: peeking out from behind something, only half visible, nervous
pose_desc.sleeping: eyes closed, tiny snore bubble, relaxed
pose_desc.shh: one paw pressed to the mouth in a shh gesture, frowning, only the upper body out of a dirt hole
pose_desc.popping: bursting up out of a dirt hole with dirt flying, startled
pose_desc.angry: frowning with crossed arms, cheeks puffed
pose_desc.drum: happily beating a small drum with two sticks, grinning

cover.desc: Picture-book cover illustration. Pip, the tiny yellow baby bird with a green leaf scarf, flies along a sunny forest path singing with its beak open and a golden note above it, with Pim and Pam, two tiny twin bluebirds (one with a red feather tuft, one with a yellow feather tuft), flying side by side next to it; Bun the white rabbit in green boots and Hedgie the hedgehog walk below, cheering; Beads the rainbow bead caterpillar rides on Hedgie's flower; up in a leafy tree, Grumble the old raccoon peeks out holding a brightly glowing lantern. Behind them, a giant friendly tree has a big round wooden door standing open with golden light inside, and more round doors glow along the path deeper in the forest. Leave a calm, simple sky area at the top for the title.
cover.ko: 표지. 숲길을 날며 노래하는 핍과 쌍둥이 파랑새 핌·팜, 그 아래 번과 헤지, 꽃 위의 비즈, 나무 위 등불 든 그럼블, 열린 둥근 문들.

front.desc: Title page vignette: a small round picture of Pip sitting between Pim and Pam on a mossy branch, all three with their beaks open together, on a plain cream background with a few green leaves. Lots of empty space around the vignette.
front.ko: 속표지. 이끼 낀 가지에 나란히 앉은 핍과 핌·팜.

front.desc: A hand-drawn storybook map of the Pair Forest seen from above: at the bottom, the far bank of the Word Pond with the finished bridge of stepping stones; a winding mossy path leads up through a dense green forest past nine round doors set in a giant tree, a hollow log, a rock, a pond bank, a clock trunk, a brick wall, a stream bank, a tent and a wall of roots, all shut; a tiny treetop bed with a lantern light; a little stream with a swing; a sandy pond; a round glade at the top edge of the forest; beyond it, on a far hill, a tiny castle. No letters or text anywhere.
front.ko: 짝꿍 숲 지도예요. 연못 건너 숲길을 따라 닫힌 둥근 문들이 있고, 숲 끝 너머 언덕에 작은 성이 보여요.

back.desc: Final page: evening at the far edge of the Pair Forest. Pip, Pim and Pam, Bun, Hedgie, Beads and Grumble sit in a row on a fallen log seen from behind, looking out over a moonlit valley toward a tall castle on a far hill; on its big gate a short glowing word shimmers as a tiny sparkling e appears at its end (the letters c, a, p and e are the ONLY text allowed in the picture); Grumble's lantern hangs on a stick beside them like a star and the crab's drum rests at his feet; behind them the open round doors glow along the forest path. Calm and warm.
back.ko: 숲 끝 통나무에 나란히 앉은 친구들의 뒷모습. 멀리 성문의 단어가 반짝이며 바뀌어요. 이야기 끝.

back.desc: The same hand-drawn map of the Pair Forest as before, but now all nine round doors along the path stand open with a warm glow, a trail of tiny bird footprints runs from the bridge all the way to the glade at the top, strings of little flags hang over the party glade, and beyond the forest edge a small path leads toward the tiny castle on the far hill, its gate glinting. No letters or text anywhere.
back.ko: 문이 모두 열린 지도. 발자국이 숲 끝까지 이어지고 성으로 가는 작은 길이 나 있어요.

style_v1.art: Children's picture-book illustration, hand-drawn 2D style, thick soft dark-brown outlines, flat bright cheerful colors with a light paper texture and gentle watercolor shading, rounded friendly shapes. No photo-realism, no 3D render look. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image.
style_v1.object: A single object only, centered, filling most of the frame, on a plain pure white background, no shadow on the ground, nothing else in the picture.
style_v1.scene: Full illustrated scene with a simple uncluttered background and a calm, simple sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind.
style_v1.character_sheet: Full body, standing, facing the viewer, friendly expression, centered on a plain pure white background, no shadow, no props beyond what is described.

story_arc.ko: 단어 연못 건너편에 짝꿍 숲이 있어요. 숲의 문은 두 글자가 함께 한 소리를 내야 열려요. 늘 붙어 다니는 쌍둥이 파랑새 핌과 팜이 두 글자를 함께 소리 내는 법을 알려 줘요. 핍은 처음엔 "스… 흐…" 따로따로 말하지만 5유닛에서 처음으로 "sh!"를 말하고, 10유닛에서 숲의 마지막 문을 열어 노래 조각 셋을 찾아요. 숲 끝 너머에는 단어가 바뀌는 성이 기다려요.
story_arc.books_ko: 옛날에 노래 나무가 부르던 소리 노래가 네 조각으로 흩어졌어요. 1권 소리 정원, 2권 단어 연못, 3권 짝꿍 숲, 4권 마법 성에서 조각을 하나씩 찾아요. 네 조각을 다 모으면 노래 나무가 다시 노래해요.
story_arc.characters_ko: 핍은 이제 짧은 단어를 읽지만 두 글자 짝꿍은 따로따로 말해요. 번과 헤지, 비즈가 함께하고, 새 친구 핌과 팜은 늘 둘이 함께 말해요. 나무 위 그럼블의 "쉿!"은 알고 보니 sh 소리 — 그럼블은 유닛마다 조금씩 내려와 마지막엔 함께 북을 쳐요.
